name: metamodel.removeRelationKind
title: Remove relation kind
summary: Remove a relation kind that no element file holds; only the metamodel files change, and no element.
details: The definition is removed from `relations` of the file it is in, with its lines and the comment lines directly above it (SR-236 AK3, AK4). No element file changes and nothing in Git (D-036); no element is deleted (D-045). Refused while the file of an element of any status holds the key, with a relation of the kind or an empty list (SR-236 AK7, SR-239 AK3); the refusal names the count and the first 20 elements. Saved filters, perspectives and mapping files that name the key are listed in `mentions` and not changed (SR-236 AK7). Errors: input.invalid with details.reason unknown when no relation kind has the key (details.relationKind); input.invalid with details.reason in-use (details.uses: kind, key, count and the short IDs of the first 20 elements in code-unit order); file.folder-missing when a repository of the workspace is not on this machine (details.repository, details.repositories); file.faulty when an element file cannot be read, as it may hold the definition (SR-236 AK7, SR-008 AK3; details.command, details.count: the number of these files, details.files: the first 20 by repository and path, each with repository and file), unless a repository is missing as well; input.invalid with details.reason metamodel-invalid and the errors in details.problems when the metamodel would have an error; workspace.read-only when the metamodel files do not give a valid metamodel or the metamodel repository is not on this machine; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder when the metamodel folder is .git or a repository of its own (D-036); file.read-only when the metamodel repository cannot be written (SR-018 AK2); file.faulty when the definition or a node on the way to it is an alias or has an anchor (details.repository, details.file, details.line); file.changed-on-disk when another process changed the file since it was read (SR-236 AK10). Nothing is written on these.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-236 AK5: a metamodel that cannot be read is never changed (SR-011 AK3).
